headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: The site as Referer and Accept: application/json on every API call; API is the path detection saw in the page's scripts.

getPopular.title: Popular
getPopular.text: GET API?page=N&sort=popular and the reply's list under data / items / results, read by the common field names. The real list path and sort parameter must be checked in the site's network calls.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: The same list sorted by update; the sort parameter is a guess.

search.title: Search
search.text: The same list with q=words; some APIs call it search, keyword or title.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: GET API/<slug or id> and the common detail fields (description, authors, genres, status).

getChapterList.title: Chapters
getChapterList.text: GET <entry>/chapters, each item's number, name and date. The chapters path is a guess until tested.

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: GET <chapter>, the picture list under images / pages / data, each a string or an object with url / image / src.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One API call read as JSON (an HTML reply is an error), list unwrapping, the common entry fields and absolute addresses.
